report.summary: Sourcing is largely sound: every rupee figure, ratio, year and growth rate I could trace converts correctly from the cited pages (PAT, EPS, operating cash flow, total assets, contingent liabilities, capital structure, customer concentration, export figure, market-size and CAGR statistics all reconcile exactly), and the promoter/related-party/risk narratives are anchored to the right pages. Six verdicts are 'partial' rather than clean: the 'listed company' descriptor and the promoter-vs-promoter-group 99.76% phrasing (p155/p162), the promoter name 20 Microns Limited on p112, Plot 9-10 appearing in a facilities sentence cited only to p20, the 'sustained negative cash flow could affect growth' warning and the five-year related-party recency attributed to excerpts that do not carry that wording (p22, p24 — the substance is on p166 and the warning text elsewhere in the same risk factor), and the 'more than 60 risk factors' over-claim where only item 60 is evidenced. None of these is a fabricated number; the only invented-sounding specific is the 'listed' status of the promoter, and it should be either sourced or cut. No unsupported or wrong-source verdicts, so blocking_count is 0.
